```{r}
## library packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(cowplot)
library(here)
library(srvyr)
library(sl3)
library(tictoc)
library(yardstick)
library(broom)

## read in death file 
death_file <- read_dta(here("data", "analysis_files", "nfhs5_deaths.DTA")) %>% 
  filter(months_since_death > 3) %>% 
  mutate(region = as_factor(region)) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  filter(death_age >= 5)


death_file <- death_file %>% 
  mutate(facility_distance_quantile = ntile(facility_distance, n = 5)) %>% 
  mutate(road_length_km_quantile = ntile(road_length_km, n = 5))
```


```{r}
death_file %>% 
  mutate(region = as_factor(region)) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  count(region)
```




```{r}
# Group data by state, then perform regression for each state
results <- death_file %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ glm(death_age ~ facility_distance_quantile + female + highest_education + external_death, 
                            data = ., family = gaussian())),
    tidy_model = map(model, tidy)
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidy_model) %>%
  select(region, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>% 
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")  # Exclude intercept for clearer interpretation
```


```{r}
# Perform grouped regression and create results table
results <- death_file %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ glm(registered ~ female, 
                            data = ., family = gaussian())),
    tidy_model = map(model, tidy)
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidy_model) %>%
  select(state, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")  # Exclude intercept for clearer interpretation

# Generate LaTeX table
results

death_file %>% 
  group_by(region, female) %>% 
  summarize(reg = mean(registered)) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarize(max(reg) - min(reg))

```


```{r}
# Define the predictors
predictors <- c("death_age", "facility_distance_quantile", "female", "highest_education", "external_death", "rural", "road_length_km", "wealth_quintile", "own_land", "internet", "native_language", "female_head")


# Initialize an empty data frame to store results
results <- data.frame()

# Loop over each state and perform univariate regressions
for (state_id in unique(death_file$region)) {
  # Filter data for the current state
  state_data <- filter(death_file, region == state_id)
  
  for (predictor in predictors) {
    # Perform univariate regression
    model <- lm(as.formula(paste("registered ~", as.factor(predictor))), data = state_data)
    
    # Manually calculate R-squared for univariate regression
    r_squared <- cor(state_data[[predictor]], state_data$registered, use = "complete.obs")^2
    
    # Extract coefficient, standard error, t-value, and p-value
    tidy_model <- tidy(model)
    predictor_row <- tidy_model %>% filter(term == predictor)
    
    # Append results to the results data frame
    results <- bind_rows(
      results,
      data.frame(
        state = state_id,
        predictor = predictor,
        estimate = predictor_row$estimate,
        std_error = predictor_row$std.error,
        t_value = predictor_row$statistic,
        p_value = predictor_row$p.value,
        r_squared = r_squared
      )
    )
  }
}

# Create a bar plot to visualize R-squared values
ggplot(results, aes(y = predictor, x = r_squared, fill = state)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Most important predictors (deaths age 5+)",
    y = "Predictor",
    x = "R-Squared",
    fill = "Region"
  ) + 
  theme_cowplot() 
```
